subject: DPA evidence request, audit access & DPIA support
messages:
From: FinCo Privacy Team <privacy@finco.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: FinCo Procurement <procurement@finco.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: DPA, subprocessors, DPIA artifacts and audit access

Hi Laura,

As part of our vendor due diligence for the upcoming platform procurement, the privacy team needs the following items to close our assessment by 2026-03-01: 

- Fully executed Data Processing Agreement (or countersigned copy) reflecting GDPR Art. 28 obligations.
- Current list of subprocessors (name, location, access scope) and whether any subprocessors transfer data outside the EEA.
- Evidence of appropriate transfer mechanisms (e.g., SCCs + UK Addendum status).
- Summary of SOC 2 and any recent penetration test reports (or a pointer to where we can view them).
- Confirmation of audit rights: whether FinCo can perform an audit, scope (remote vs on-site), and any limitations.
- Support for our DPIA: a copy of Redwood's DPIA template or willingness to participate in a joint DPIA workshop.

Would you be able to provide these artifacts or point us to the secure location where we can retrieve them? If an on-site audit is necessary, please advise logistics and estimated lead time.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
FinCo Privacy Team
privacy@finco.com

[This request will be shared with procurement for timeline alignment.]

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: FinCo Privacy Team <privacy@finco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, FinCo Procurement <procurement@finco.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: DPA, subprocessors, DPIA artifacts and audit access

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the clear list. We're committed to supporting your assessment and can provide most artifacts and a formal process for audits. Quick notes: 

- I'll attach the latest DPA draft for your legal team. We typically sign the DPA + SCCs; UK Addendum is in flight for customers in the UK.
- Monica (privacy) will send the current subprocessor registry and SOC 2 summary.
- We offer a remote, read-only audit via our secure audit portal by default; on-site audits can be arranged with advance notice and an agreed scope.
- We can participate in a DPIA workshop and provide an export of our Article 30 records.

Proposed immediate next steps: Monica to share artifacts; Rishi to confirm audit/legal constraints; if you can share a preferred window for a remote session (we have limited staff the week of 2026-02-29).

Regards,

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_dpa_v3.pdf (PDF, 128KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: FinCo Privacy Team <privacy@finco.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-21T09:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: DPA, subprocessors, DPIA artifacts and audit access

Hi Aisha and team,

Attaching the current subprocessor registry and a short SOC 2 summary. Notes on the items you asked for: 

- Subprocessors: see attached CSV (name, country, processing purpose, contract scope). We flag any subprocessors that transfer data outside the EEA.
- SCCs: We have SCCs signed with primary subprocessors. The execution status report is attached; for a few older vendors we are in the final stages of completing SCC amendments.
- Audit rights: Redwood permits remote audits for customers under the DPA. Typical constraints: auditors access logs and configuration via our secure audit portal; no direct shell/console access; no extraction of raw customer content unless mutually agreed with redaction. We ask external auditors to sign our vendor auditor NDA and limit sampling windows to reduce privacy exposure.
- DPIA support: We can provide our DPIA template and nominate a privacy engineer to join your workshop. We can also provide an export of a redacted Article 30 records extract for your DPIA.

Attachments included: [subprocessors_list_2026-02-20.csv], [redwood_dpa_v3.pdf (attached by Laura)], [soc2-summary-2025Q4.pdf (summary, 45KB)].

If you prefer an on-site audit, please provide a draft scope; lead time is typically 6 weeks. For remote sessions we can offer a 90-minute walkthrough plus a time-limited read-only session (we log and watermark sessions).

Regards,

Monica Patel
Privacy & Compliance Manager
monica@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: subprocessors_list_2026-02-20.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

From: FinCo Privacy Team <privacy@finco.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: FinCo Procurement <procurement@finco.com>
Date: 2026-02-22T15:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: DPA, subprocessors, DPIA artifacts and audit access

Thanks Monica, Laura — helpful. A few clarifying items before we schedule: 

1) SCCs/UK addendum: can you confirm which subprocessors do not yet have executed SCCs and whether a UK Addendum will be available by 2026-03-01?
2) Audit scope: we prefer remote first. For the remote session we will need read access to audit logs (S3 access logs, request logs) for a rolling 30-day window and confirmation of redaction processes for content used in model fine-tuning.
3) DPIA: we'd like Redwood to participate in a 2-hour DPIA workshop week of 2026-02-29. Our procurement deadline is 2026-03-01, so timeline is tight.

Can you confirm by EOD 2026-02-23? If not possible, please propose the earliest available slot for the remote audit.

Best,
Aisha Khan
FinCo Privacy Team
privacy@finco.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: FinCo Privacy Team <privacy@finco.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-24T10:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: DPA, subprocessors, DPIA artifacts and audit access

Hi Aisha — quick update and confirmations below. Apologies for the slight delay; wanted to confirm internal signoffs.

- SCCs / UK Addendum: Current state attached (scc-execution-status.txt). Most production subprocessors have SCCs in place; three smaller vendors are completing SCC execution and we expect finalization by 2026-03-05. The UK Addendum is being applied customer-by-customer; for FinCo we can accelerate and target 2026-03-03 delivery.

- Audit access: We can provision a remote, time-limited read-only session into our secure audit portal. This includes access to configuration, request logs, and anonymized S3 access logs (we provide a redacted export). Direct raw content exports are not permitted unless pre-approved and redacted. For traceability, all sessions are recorded and watermark-stamped. Attached is a sample log export (s3-access-audit-log-stub.txt).

- DPIA support: Monica will lead the 2-hr DPIA workshop. We are available 2026-03-01 09:00-11:00 UTC or 2026-03-03 14:00-16:00 UTC — please confirm preferred slot. We will produce an Article 30 records extract and a DPIA template in advance.

Next steps: 
- Laura: counterparty legal to review the attached DPA and confirm execution path.
- Monica / Rishi: prepare redacted Article 30 extract and schedule remote audit portal access.

Please confirm which workshop slot works and whether the remote audit window should be 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-04.

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
[Attachments: scc-execution-status.txt (text, 2KB), s3-access-audit-log-stub.txt (text, 8KB)]
